description: Algorithms for computing gravitational forces between N bodies, from brute-force O(N^2) to hierarchical O(N log N) and multipole O(N) methods
mathematical_formalization: F_ij = G * m_i * m_j * r_ij / (|r_ij|^2 + eps^2)^(3/2); Total force on i: F_i = sum_{j!=i} F_ij
analogical_connections: kernel methods in ML (similar N^2 bottleneck)
implementation_hypothesis: Vectorized numpy brute-force for N<200, Barnes-Hut quadtree for N>200; softening parameter epsilon prevents singularities
experiment_seed: Compare force accuracy and timing between brute-force and Barnes-Hut at N=100, 500, 1000 with theta=0.5
